title: LoanLapse: A Synthetic Dataset of Control Failures in Agentic Loan-Underwriting Workflows
description: 308 fully synthetic, deterministically generated cases of control failures in an agentic loan-underwriting workflow. Each case carries a rule-based ground-truth control decision (ALLOW / HOLD / DENY) on the action at a workflow gate, so detection methods can be scored against one consistent ground truth. No real data; no model is a label source.
